name: io.github.tsushanth/realtime-tts-mcp
description: MCP server for ReadAloud's realtime streaming text-to-speech API (Kokoro-82M) as a single synthesize_speech tool. Free API key, 10,000 free characters, sub-second warm latency. Returns playable WAV audio.

environmentVariables.description: Your ReadAloud API key. Get a free one (10,000 free characters, no card required) at https://readaloudai.org/developers
environmentVariables.name: REALTIME_TTS_API_KEY
